new_page.title: Speculation and Vacancy Tax in Surrey, Langley & Fraser Valley (2026)
new_page.h1: Does the speculation and vacancy tax apply in Surrey, Langley and the Fraser Valley?
new_page.description: Surrey, White Rock, both Langleys, Abbotsford, Chilliwack and Mission are taxable areas. 2026 rates are 1% for Canadians and 3% for foreign owners.

breadcrumbs.name: Does the speculation and vacancy tax apply in Surrey, Langley and the Fraser Valley?

faq.q: Do I have to declare if I live in my home?
faq.a: Yes. Every owner of residential property in a taxable area declares every year, even when the home is exempt. You can declare once you receive the letter the Province mails.

faq.q: Is the speculation tax the same as Vancouver's empty homes tax?
faq.a: No. The empty homes tax is the City of Vancouver's own tax. The speculation and vacancy tax is provincial and covers all the areas listed here.

parts.t: Yes. Surrey, White Rock, the City and Township of Langley, Delta, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Abbotsford, Chilliwack and Mission are all taxable areas. Every residential owner there must declare each year by March 31. Most owners who live in their home or rent it out are exempt, but they still have to declare.

items.t: 1% of assessed value: Canadian citizens and permanent residents
3% of assessed value: foreign owners and untaxed worldwide earners (including satellite families)
From January 1, 2027 the foreign owner rate rises to 4%; the 1% rate stays

parts.t: For 2025 the rates were 0.5% and 2%. Tax for a calendar year is due the following July.

items.t: Principal residence: an owner who lives and works in BC and lives in the home
Rented: a tenant occupies the home for at least six months of the calendar year

parts.t: A second home or a condo left empty most of the year is where owners get caught. Check before you buy a second property in a taxable area.

Fraser Valley: Abbotsford, Chilliwack and Mission. Metro Vancouver: Burnaby, Coquitlam, Delta, Langley City, Township of Langley, Maple Ridge, New Westminster, North Vancouver (City and District), Pitt Meadows, Port Coquitlam, Port Moody, Richmond, Surrey, Vancouver, West Vancouver, White Rock, Anmore, Belcarra, UBC and the University Endowment Lands.
Read on November 18, 2026. Rules change, so confirm with the source or your lawyer, notary or accountant before you act.
